load_error_description: Check your connection and try again.
manage_account_description: You can change your account username and password.
manage_data_description: You can export your account data for backup and restore.
manage_data_warning: Overwriting replaces all of your current data.
notifications_intro: Genshin Schedule has a Discord bot that can send you notifications when your resin reaches a certain level (configurable in {settings}).
notifications_step_invite: 1. Invite the bot to your server. The bot and you need to share a common server in order for the bot to be able to message you.
notifications_step_message: 3. Copy the following message (you must be signed in) and send it to the bot via DM. Don't share this message with anyone else, ever!
notifications_step_privacy: 2. Make sure DMs from server members are enabled, otherwise the bot cannot message you.
notifications_step_success: The bot should inform you that the process succeeded:
password_reuse_warning: Never reuse your HoYoverse password on Genshin-related websites.
sign_in_description: Signing in will enable synchronization across multiple devices. If you do not already have an account, it will be created automatically.
sync_error_description: Could not synchronize changes at the moment. Please try again later.
welcome_features: Mobile-friendly, dark mode, supports syncing across devices, and can ping you on Discord if your resin reaches a configurable level.
welcome_intro: A simple app for keeping track of your resin in Genshin Impact.
welcome_resin_calculator: Tracks your resin and estimates when it will recharge without having to open the game.
